description: This file defines the 'StatusInfo' class and its nested 'Status' enum, which are used to represent and serialize health check status information within a system. It includes methods for creating, combining, and serializing status reports, as well as handling detailed messages and sub-statuses (children).

classes.name: StatusInfo
classes.description: Represents system health status with optional details and hierarchical children, capable of JSON serialization and composite status calculation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo instance with specified status, details, children, and label.

methods.name: unknown
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance representing an unknown status.

methods.name: fromStatus
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo from a given status, with optional message or details.

methods.name: fromDetail
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo from a single detail message.

methods.name: fromDetails
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo from a collection of details.

methods.name: composite
methods.description: Creates a composite StatusInfo from a list or map of child StatusInfos, merging their statuses.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a StatusInfo from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Returns the list of detail messages.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the list of child StatusInfos.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the label if present.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Creates a new StatusInfo with the specified label.

methods.name: isComposite
methods.description: Checks if this StatusInfo has sub-statuses.

methods.name: addDetail
methods.description: Returns a new StatusInfo with an added detail, updating status accordingly.

methods.name: isHealthy
methods.description: Returns true if status is not DOWN.
